description:
SAIC has a position open for a  Software Developer located in  Huntsville, AL . The selected candidate will be a member of a team providing hardware and software development and test support to the US ARMY.   

 Job Responsibilities:  

 The candidate perform a variety of engineering tasks, either independently or under supervision, which are broad in nature and are concerned with the design and implementation, including personnel, hardware, software and support facilities and/or equipment. 

 JOB DESCRIPTION:  

 The candidate will be responsible for developing systems and software architectures, managing software requirements, and developing embedded software solutions. The applicant must be able to review system and subsystem specifications and interface documentation for completeness, accuracy, and applicability. Candidate will support and participate in system/subsystem design, trade-off and performance studies and analyses; interpret and analyze requirements obtained/derived from customer; review, verify and/or validate system specifications and other design-related documentation; and hardware and software design review, technical interchange and management control meetings, and configuration control boards.  


 EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS: 
 BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline is required and five (5)+ years of related experience is required; Additional six (6) years’ experience can be considered in lieu of degree. 
  
 CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS: 
 Must possess an active Secret security clearance; US Citizenship required. 
  
 REQUIRED SKILLS:  
 Must have a working knowledge of Linux Operating Systems, C++ 
 Object Oriented Development using the Unified Modeling Language (UML)in a embedded environment.  
 Candidates must also have a strong knowledge of all software development processes, documentation, and CMMI.  
  
 DESIRED SKILLS:  
 Experience with VxWorks, IBM Rhapsody, and IBM DOORS.
